findings.evidence: Proof uses `(by rintro _ rfl; exact hJ₀.comp hinj)`. `Analysis/Normed/Module/TotallyReal.lean:47` reads `(hJA : ∀ p ∈ s, Function.Injective (p.2.comp p.1))`.
findings.fix: Replace `hJ₀` with `hJ₀ : Injective (J₀.comp (mfderiv I' I ι x₀))` and pass it straight through. The family corollaries can still prove it from `(J.freeze p₀).injective`.
findings.issue: `exists_pos_eventually_isMaximalTotallyReal_range_mfderiv` assumes `hJ₀ : Injective J₀`, but the proof only uses it as `hJ₀.comp hinj` to get `Injective (J₀ ∘L mfderiv I' I ι x₀)`. That composite is exactly the hypothesis `hJA` of `exists_pos_isMaximalTotallyReal_range_of_isCompact`. `L ⊕ J₀L = E` with `J₀` injective on `L` does not make `J₀` injective on all of `E`, so the assumption is strictly stronger than needed, which goes against the file's stated aim of imposing nothing on the perturbed operators beyond closeness.

findings.evidence: In both proofs, `hJ` appears only in the call `exists_pos_eventually_isMaximalTotallyReal_range_mfderiv (hι _ _) (hinj _ _) (hJ _ _) (h _ _)`.
findings.fix: Weaken both to `∀ x ∈ K, Injective ((𝒥 t₀ (ι x)).comp (mfderiv I' I ι x))` (respectively `(J₀ (ι x)).comp (mfderiv I' I ι x)`).
findings.issue: The same over-strong hypothesis is passed on in `eventually_forall_isMaximalTotallyReal_of_isCompact` as `hJ : ∀ x ∈ K, Injective (𝒥 t₀ (ι x))` and in `exists_pos_forall_isMaximalTotallyReal_of_isCompact` as `hJ : ∀ x ∈ K, Injective (J₀ (ι x))`. Both are used only to feed the local form.

summary: The local, compact and family stability forms are pitched at the right level, but the three tangent-level statements ask for `J₀` to be injective on the whole tangent space when injectivity on the tangent image `im dι` is enough. The linear theorem they rely on only needs the weaker hypothesis.
